name: EPR g-tensor + hyperfine (B3LYP)
template:
# EPR: electronic g-tensor + per-nucleus hyperfine coupling (isotropic A_iso +
# dipolar) for an OPEN-SHELL species. The molecule MUST be a radical -- set its
# charge/multiplicity in the Molecules tab (e.g. a neutral doublet = charge 0,
# mult 2). Run on an optimised geometry.
#
# NOTE: ORCA requires the coordinates to appear BEFORE the %eprnmr block when
# 'Nuclei = all' is used -- the COORDS placeholder below is positioned accordingly.
#
# B3LYP is the EPR workhorse. For more accurate hyperfine, use a basis with a
# flexible/decontracted core on the spin-bearing atom (EPR-II for H-F, or
# aug-cc-pVTZ-J / pcSseg-2 / CP(PPP) on a metal). Add CPCM(solvent) for solution.

! UKS B3LYP def2-TZVP TightSCF

%maxcore 3000

%pal nprocs 8
end

!!##COORDS_SEC##!!

%eprnmr
  gtensor 1
  Nuclei = all { aiso, adip }
end
